blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: В ___ (некоторые семья, prep. pl.) есть горничные.
exercises.prompt: Some families have maids.
exercises.why: **семья → семьях** (prep. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural семьи. Declines like DLI's семья — every plural form has the same endings (P. pl. семьях). Ending -я → -ях.  Declension: sg. семья · семьи · семье · семью · семьёй · семье; pl. семьи · семей · семьям · семьи · семьями · семьях.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. The formation of these cases does not depend upon the gender of the noun, but only upon the sound preceding the ending.» — DLI, Lessons 42–45.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Покажи на ___ (карта, prep. sg.) Пуэрто-Рико.
exercises.prompt: Locate Puerto Rico on a map.
exercises.why: **карта → карте** (prep. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. газете). Ending -а → -е.  Declension: sg. карта · карты · карте · карту · картой · карте; pl. карты · карт · картам · карты · картами · картах.  «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. … The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Гостиницы содержатся здесь в ___ (необычайная чистота, prep. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The hotels here are kept unusually clean.
exercises.why: **чистота → чистоте** (prep. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. газете). Ending -а → -е.  **необычайный → необычайной** (prep. sg. f., agreeing with чистоте). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): P. новой. Ending -ая → -ой.  Declension: sg. чистота · чистоты · чистоте · чистоту · чистотой · чистоте; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. … The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. In spite of -ш-, «большая» belongs to the guttural type: большой, большую.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Стой! На ___ (дорога, prep. sg.) олень.
exercises.prompt: Stop! There's a deer on the road.
exercises.why: **дорога → дороге** (prep. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. газете). Ending -а → -е.  Declension: sg. дорога · дороги · дороге · дорогу · дорогой · дороге; pl. дороги · дорог · дорогам · дороги · дорогами · дорогах.  «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. … The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Утром на ___ (земля, prep. sg.) лежал иней.
exercises.prompt: The ground was covered with frost this morning.
exercises.why: **земля → земле** (prep. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. неделе). Ending -я → -е.  Declension: sg. земля · земли · земле · землю · землёй · земле; pl. земли · земель · землям · земли · землями · землях.  «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. … The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том зашёл в комнату в ___ (купальный халат, prep. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom came into the room wearing a bathrobe.
exercises.why: **халат → халате** (prep. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. доме). Ending — (no ending) → -е.  **купальный → купальном** (prep. sg. m., agreeing with халате). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): P. новом. Ending -ый → -ом.  Declension: sg. халат · халата · халату · халат · халатом · халате; pl. халаты · халатов · халатам · халаты · халатами · халатах.  «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. … The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Что это за наросты на ___ (дубовый лист, prep. pl.)?
exercises.prompt: What are those outgrowths on the oak leaves?
exercises.why: **лист → листьях** (prep. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural листы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (P. pl. столах). Ending — (no ending) → -ьях.  **дубовый → дубовых** (prep. pl., agreeing with листьях). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): P. новых. Ending -ые → -ых.  Declension: sg. лист · листа · листу · лист · листом · листе; pl. листы · листов · листам · листы · листами · листах.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. The formation of these cases does not depend upon the gender of the noun, but only upon the sound preceding the ending.» — DLI, Lessons 42–45.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (дупло, prep. sg.) дерева гнездо.
exercises.prompt: There's a nest in the tree hollow.
exercises.why: **дупло → дупле** (prep. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. окне). Ending -о → -е. exercises.q: Мне дают дополнительное время на ___ (экзамен, prep. pl.), потому что я дислексик.

Ending — (no ending) → -ах.  Declension: sg. экзамен · экзамена · экзамену · экзамен · экзаменом · экзамене; pl. экзамены · экзаменов · экзаменам · экзамены · экзаменами · экзаменах.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. exercises.q: Тигры живут в ___ (тропическая леса, prep. pl.), а львы - в саваннах.
exercises.prompt: Tigers live in the jungle, lions in the savanna.
exercises.why: **леса → лесах** (prep. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural лесы. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (P. pl. газетах). Ending -а → -ах.  **тропический → тропических** (prep. pl., agreeing with лесах). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): P. русских. Ending -ие → -их.  Declension: sg. леса · лесы · лесе · лесу · лесой · лесе; pl. лесы · лес · лесам · лесы · лесами · лесах.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. The formation of these cases does not depend upon the gender of the noun, but only upon the sound preceding the ending.» — DLI, Lessons 42–45.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Она на ___ (последнее издыхание, prep. sg.).
exercises.prompt: It's on its last legs.
exercises.why: **издыхание → издыхании** (prep. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. здании). Ending -е → -и.  **последний → последнем** (prep. sg. n., agreeing with издыхании). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): P. синем. Ending -ее → -ем.  Declension: sg. издыхание · издыхания · издыханию · издыхание · издыханием · издыхании; pl. издыхания · издыханий · издыханиям · издыхания · издыханиями · издыханиях.  «If the stem of the noun ends in и-, the prepositional case singular has another -и as the ending (instead of -е): Россия — в России, здание — в здании.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
